m.english: 'And since then I let my bat do the talking.'

target.text: E, desde então, deixei o meu taco falar.

translation.text: 'And since then I let my bat do the talking.'

m.target: E, desde então, deixei o meu taco falar.

m.english: I'll take out the big stick 'cause it's fun to hit 'em far.

target.text: Pego no taco grande porque é divertido bater para longe.

translation.text: I'll take out the big stick 'cause it's fun to hit 'em far.

m.target: Pego no taco grande porque é divertido bater para longe.

m.english: And that same golf club is our murder weapon.

target.text: E o mesmo taco de golfe é a nossa arma do crime.

translation.text: And that same golf club is our murder weapon.

m.target: E o mesmo taco de golfe é a nossa arma do crime.

m.english: Your bat does the talking. ..but they give the orders.

target.text: O teu taco fala por ti, mas eles dão as ordens.

translation.text: Your bat does the talking. ..but they give the orders.

m.target: O teu taco fala por ti, mas eles dão as ordens.

m.english: You think maybe you need a lighter bat?

target.text: Achas que precisas de um taco mais leve?

translation.text: You think maybe you need a lighter bat?

m.target: Achas que precisas de um taco mais leve?

m.english: We find that golf club, we get to the killer.

target.text: Se encontrarmos o taco de golfe, chegamos ao assassino.

translation.text: We find that golf club, we get to the killer.

m.target: Se encontrarmos o taco de golfe, chegamos ao assassino.

u.english: Have your tacos. I'll wait out here.

target.text: Come o taco à vontade, espero por ti aqui.

translation.text: Have your tacos. I'll wait out here.

u.target: Come o taco à vontade, espero por ti aqui.

u.english: All he cared about was raising his bat in the air.. ..after completing his century.

target.text: Só se importava em levantar o taco depois de chegar aos 100 pontos.

translation.text: All he cared about was raising his bat in the air.. ..after completing his century.

u.target: Só se importava em levantar o taco depois de chegar aos 100 pontos.
